title: How to Fix America's Corrupt Political System
summary: A short RepresentUs explainer on how money corrupts American politics and what an anti-corruption act could do about it. It covers lobbying, super PACs and campaign finance, and pitches the group's proposed reforms. The video was later superseded by an updated version.
why: HN commenters cite it as a brief summary of the problem and the proposed Anti-Corruption Act solution when arguing for getting money out of politics.

quote.text: I find these videos to be helpful in briefly understanding the problem and their proposed solution
